Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
"If Valerie is in combat with a vampire you can burn 1 pool once each round to make her immune to all non-aggravated damage from a strike or damaging effect."

So "A strike or damaging effect."
That's singular, not plural.

So, let's say she's rushed by Enkidu. Big crows, plus hands. You can only prevent the 3 hands or 2 birds, right?

Because wording?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> ReverendRevolver wrote:
> "If Valerie is in combat with a vampire you can burn 1 pool once each round to make her immune to all non-aggravated damage from a strike or damaging effect."
>
> So "A strike or damaging effect."
> That's singular, not plural.
>
> So, let's say she's rushed by Enkidu. Big crows, plus hands. You can only prevent the 3 hands or 2 birds, right?
>
Correct. You choose to prevent either the damage from the strike, or the damage from the damaging effect (the Carrion Crows).
